looks.title: White cathedral + the X
looks.intent: The nave of cold white pillars from the column bases into the roof, and the X: three PARs from each end of the cut crossing a metre over the DJ's head. Everything else dark.

looks.title: Red room
looks.intent: Deep red only: the columns, the press at full and the bridge frame; the cut itself dark, a black slash across the red.

looks.title: The hit
looks.intent: The peak: the curtain and the X at full white on black (the COBs' own strobe on a console), everything else out.

looks.title: Blackout + one shaft
looks.intent: Everything out but one: the curtain's centre COB straight down on the DJ — a shaft of white in the haze, the DJ inside it.

looks.title: The blade
looks.intent: The curtain on: seven COBs straight down under the cut, a sheet of white whose top edge is the slope; the bridge a low red frame, the columns and the press glowing up out of the dark in red.
